tasks.title: Alarm persistence isolation (1.4): fault-injection repro, then isolate both mark_triggered call sites with retry
tasks.description: Repro-first: add fault-injection tests proving a DB failure in AlarmStore.mark_triggered aborts the bar path (no emit, no in-memory update, _last_chart_price stalls), then isolate both call sites in ui/ticker_session.py (_on_aggregated_bar and _evaluate_burst_alarms): catch the DB error, log with symbol plus alarm context, still set alarm.triggered, still emit, still advance _last_chart_price, and queue the alarm ID for retry flushed on subsequent bars and reload_alarms. The store signature stays frozen.
acceptance_criteria: Given an injected mark_triggered DB failure at either call site, when a bar is processed, then the alarm notification is still emitted, alarm.triggered is set True, and _last_chart_price still advances for that bar.
Given such a persistence failure, when it is caught, then an error is logged carrying the symbol and alarm-ID context.
Given failed alarm IDs queued for retry, when a subsequent bar is processed or reload_alarms runs, then the retry flushes with no duplicate emissions for already-notified alarms.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given an injected mark_triggered DB failure at either call site, when a bar is processed, then the alarm notification is still emitted, alarm.triggered is set True, and _last_chart_price still advances for that bar.
tests.description: Monkeypatch AlarmStore.mark_triggered to raise on the _on_aggregated_bar path with a live alarm; drive one aggregated bar offscreen and assert emit plus triggered plus price advance. Red on the current tree (bar path aborts), green after.
tests.expected_result: Fails pre-fix (no emit, triggered unset, price stalled); passes post-fix.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given an injected mark_triggered DB failure at either call site, when a bar is processed, then the alarm notification is still emitted, alarm.triggered is set True, and _last_chart_price still advances for that bar.
tests.description: Same injected failure on the _evaluate_burst_alarms path with a volume-burst alarm; drive one bar and assert emit plus triggered plus price advance. Red pre-fix, green post-fix.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given failed alarm IDs queued for retry, when a subsequent bar is processed or reload_alarms runs, then the retry flushes with no duplicate emissions for already-notified alarms.
tests.description: Fail once, then restore mark_triggered; drive a subsequent bar and call reload_alarms; assert the queue drains and exactly one emission per alarm occurred in total.
tests.expected_result: Retry flushes on next bar and on reload_alarms with no duplicate emits.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given such a persistence failure, when it is caught, then an error is logged carrying the symbol and alarm-ID context.
tests.description: Capture logs around an injected failure; assert the record names the symbol and the alarm ID.
tests.expected_result: Error log contains symbol and alarm-ID context.

expected_artifacts: isolated call sites plus retry queue in ui/ticker_session.py

tasks.title: Group-color pipeline (3.1): active group plus color into the LWC commit payload with symbol validation
tasks.description: Add active-group tool state (setActiveGroup(id, color), the single writer) to chart_assets/lwc/gestures.js so drawingItem stamps the active group ID and intended color instead of null and default; forward via PageDrawing unchanged through _on_page_drawing_committed; validate in MainWindow._on_drawing_created that the submitted group belongs to the drawing symbol (else coerce to None) before create_drawing; re-push the setter from _apply_active_draw_group on every group reload and symbol change.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected draw group, when a new LWC drawing commits, then the persisted drawing carries the set's ID and its color; an ungrouped creation keeps the default color and a null group.
Given a commit payload whose group ID belongs to another symbol, when _on_drawing_created persists, then the group coerces to None with no cross-symbol write and no crash.
Given a group reload or symbol change, when _apply_active_draw_group runs, then the JS active-group state is re-pushed so the page cannot desync from the toolbar.

tasks.title: Recolor semantics (3.3): stored colors, member repaint, leave-group rule, D50 composition
tasks.description: Implement owner decision (c) Both: creation already stamps the group color via P9-T4; group recolor repaints all current members by updating their stored Drawing.color values (member-repaint, one UPDATE per recolor); ungroup and reassign preserve each drawing's stored color (never reset to default); edited drawings keep stored colors through the D50 drag path, which is verified for composition but not re-implemented. Serializer and drawing_op visibility unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Given a group recolor, when committed, then every current member's stored Drawing.color is repainted to the new color.
Given an ungroup or reassignment, when applied, then the drawing keeps its stored color and never resets to the default; drawings that left the group earlier keep the color they had.
Given a drag edit through the D50 drag path, when applied, then the drawing's stored color is preserved.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a group recolor, when committed, then every current member's stored Drawing.color is repainted to the new color.
tests.description: Create a group with two member drawings, recolor via _recolor_group offscreen; assert both stored colors equal the new color. Red pre-fix (members unchanged), green post-fix.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given an ungroup or reassignment, when applied, then the drawing keeps its stored color and never resets to the default; drawings that left the group earlier keep the color they had.
tests.description: Ungroup and reassign member drawings; assert stored colors survive in both directions and an earlier-leaver keeps its color through a later recolor.
tests.expected_result: Stored colors survive ungroup, reassign, and later recolors.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a drag edit through the D50 drag path, when applied, then the drawing's stored color is preserved.
tests.description: Apply drag_drawing_item geometry to a grouped drawing payload; assert the stored color is untouched by the geometry move.
tests.expected_result: Drag edits preserve stored colors (composition verified).
